name: How many animals
summary: TGG relays Game Informer's preview that the game has more than 170 animal species, native and invasive.
body: He relays The Guardian's preview that 62 of them are birds. Manatees, iguanas and macaque monkeys are named alongside alligators and flamingos, with rare and legendary animals to find.
These counts come from press previews as he reports them, not from Rockstar's own pages.
